label: TikTok

operations.name: get_authenticated_user_info
operations.description: Get the authenticated user's TikTok profile and statistics

operations.name: list_user_public_videos
operations.description: List the authenticated user's recent public videos

operations.name: query_video_metrics_by_id
operations.description: Query specific videos by ID to retrieve their metrics and details

operations.name: upload_video_to_creator_inbox
operations.description:
Upload a video to TikTok creator inbox as a draft via PULL_FROM_URL (requires video.upload scope).
    The creator receives an inbox notification and can review/edit before posting.
    To publish straight to the profile instead, use the Direct Post Video operation.

operations.name: check_video_publish_status
operations.description: Check the status of a pending or completed video publish operation

operations.name: query_creator_info
operations.description:
Query the creator's posting options before a direct post (privacy options,
    interaction toggles, max video duration). Requires video.publish scope.

operations.name: direct_post_video
operations.description:
Publish directly to TikTok without an inbox confirmation. Hosted media uses
    PULL_FROM_URL from a TikTok-verified domain. Requires video.publish and an
    approved Direct Post audit for public posting.

operations.name: direct_post_photo
operations.description:
Publish a photo carousel directly to the creator's TikTok profile. Photos
    are pulled by TikTok from public URLs. Requires video.publish scope.
